paper_title: Audio-Visual Efficient Conformer for Robust Speech Recognition
caption: Audio-only back-end modules FLOPs (Billion).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the Module Giga FLOPs for different attention mechanisms within three stages of an audio back-end Conformer model, as detailed in the paper "Audio-Visual Efficient Conformer for Robust Speech Recognition." The horizontal axis, labeled "Audio back-end Conformer Stage," categorizes the data into three groups: "Stage 1 (d=180, n=500)," "Stage 2 (d=256, n=250)," and "Stage 3 (d=360, n=125)." The vertical axis, labeled "Module Giga FLOPs," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.3, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Within each stage, four colored bars represent different mechanisms: blue for "attention," red for "grouped attention (g=3)," yellow for "patch attention (k=3)," and green for "feed-forward." In Stage 1, the blue "attention" bar is the tallest at approximately 0.28 Giga FLOPs, followed by the red "grouped attention (g=3)" at about 0.15 Giga FLOPs, the yellow "patch attention (k=3)" at approximately 0.11 Giga FLOPs, and the green "feed-forward" at around 0.12 Giga FLOPs. In Stage 2, the blue "attention" bar is approximately 0.16 Giga FLOPs, the red "grouped attention (g=3)" is about 0.11 Giga FLOPs, the yellow "patch attention (k=3)" is around 0.10 Giga FLOPs, and the green "feed-forward" is approximately 0.12 Giga FLOPs. In Stage 3, the blue "attention" bar is approximately 0.11 Giga FLOPs, the red "grouped attention (g=3)" is about 0.10 Giga FLOPs, the yellow "patch attention (k=3)" is around 0.10 Giga FLOPs, and the green "feed-forward" is approximately 0.12 Giga FLOPs. The bars are grouped by stage and are not sorted; all bars within each stage are displayed in the same order as defined by the legend. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their standard presentation.
